intro: Market data analysis techniques rely on clean data and clear focus rather than just complex software. You spend most of your day preparing data, but your true value lies in the strategy you build from it.
tldr: Market researchers spend 80 percent of their time cleaning data.
Communication and admin tasks consume over half of your working week.
Lazur helps you reclaim focus by handling research queries and drafting reports.
Use your Mac to manage data pipelines while Lazur manages the interruptions.

stats.label: Time spent on communication and meetings

blocks.text: Why data cleaning takes up your day

The most common mistake in market research is underestimating the time required for data preparation. You likely spend hours fixing formatting errors, removing duplicate entries, and reconciling sources from different platforms. This is the reality of the 80 percent rule. When you spend your morning scrubbing raw data, you have less energy for the actual modeling and strategy that stakeholders pay you for.
Common market data analysis techniques on Mac

Modern analysts on macOS use a mix of specialized tools. For survey collection, you might use Typeform or Qualtrics. For qualitative analysis, NVivo is a standard choice. Business intelligence often happens in Tableau or Microsoft Power BI. While these apps run in the cloud, managing them on a Mac requires a tight workflow. You need to switch between tabs and apps without losing your train of thought.

Communication is a massive burden. You spend 57 percent of your time in meetings, email, or chat. Each interruption costs you over 23 minutes to refocus. If you are constantly checking your inbox, you will never finish that complex regression model. Try to batch your email checks to specific times. Use your Mac to create focus modes that silence notifications during your deep work sessions.
Hold fn to dictate your replies to emails. This saves you from typing and keeps your hands on the keyboard for data work.
blocks.title: Dictate your emails

blocks.text: How to use Lazur for market research

Lazur lives in your Mac notch. It acts as an assistant that sees your screen and answers your questions. When you are stuck on a specific data analysis technique, hold Option and Command to ask Lazur for help. It can guide you through complex steps in Excel or Google Sheets. It does not click buttons for you, but it points at the correct menu items so you can complete the task quickly.

Translating insights into reports takes about 10 percent of your time. This is where you need clarity and speed. When drafting your findings, use Lazur to format your notes. You can speak your thoughts while looking at your data, and Lazur will draft the text directly into your document. This keeps your flow consistent and reduces the time spent switching between your research and your report.

items: Audit your time for one week to see where you lose the most hours.
Automate data cleaning where possible using built in features like Power Query.
Use keyboard shortcuts to navigate your Mac apps faster.
Limit email checks to three specific times per day.
Keep your data sources organized in local folders to reduce search time.

faq.question: Does Lazur change my data files directly?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not edit your files, click buttons, or operate other apps for you. It provides guidance and answers questions.

faq.question: Is my research data private?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur only sees your screen when you hold the shortcut. Data is not stored, and your content is never used to train models.

faq.question: Can I use Lazur on Windows?
faq.answer: Lazur is currently designed for macOS only. A Windows version is planned for the future.
